description: Long operations that own their transaction and run alone: transcription, cleanup, overlay design, history, import, export.

actions.description: Transcribe the project speech using the app transcription workflow.
Run the app one-click AI cleanup workflow on the project.
Trim silences using the app silence trimming workflow. With clipIDs, only silences inside those main-track clips are cut; without, the whole timeline is trimmed.

Overlay work that needs judgement over the speech. mode placeImported puts imported media on the timeline at the moments they fit the speech, with any sounds or on-screen words asked for on them, for example a cha-ching exactly when a number is said. mediaIDs are the unused imports to place (media with onMainTrack and usedAsOverlay both false); leave it out to use every unused import. Media already on the timeline is never placed again. mode create designs new visuals (charts, counters, animated graphics) that do not exist yet. mode revise changes generated overlays: mediaIDs are their kind scene media. mode revealNumbers makes the numbers in one image overlay appear as they are spoken: mediaIDs is that image or its spoken reveal. Pass the creator's whole request as the instruction; the workflow reads the transcript itself. Sounds on existing overlays or cuts, sounds or text alone at speech moments, and volume changes use the audio and text actions, not this. Never use this to edit existing masks.
Undo or redo the last saved edit, including a whole Chirpy batch. Runs alone and uses the existing history stack. Check canUndo/canRedo.
Open the same local file picker as Import media or Import audio, then import the creator-selected files. You cannot choose filesystem paths. Runs alone. The creator may cancel.

Export the current edited video. destination=file opens the normal save panel. Use poster only when explicitly asked to send the final video to Poster: it uploads the export and opens Poster without publishing. Runs alone.
